data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **VP – Infrastructure, Cloud and Operations** 
 , reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. The role will lead enterprise\-wide infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, and technology operations, ensuring a secure, scalable, and high\-performance digital foundation across Dubai Holding’s diverse portfolio.
 



  





 This is a critical leadership role driving the evolution of infrastructure from traditional operations to AI\-enabled, autonomous platforms, while ensuring strong commercial discipline, resilience, and service excellence.
 



  





 If you are ready to operate at the intersection of technology, business, and transformation, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Strategy \& Transformation** 



* Define and execute Dubai Holding’s enterprise infrastructure and cloud strategy aligned to business growth and digital ambitions
* Lead large\-scale transformation of legacy environments into modern, cloud\-native and hybrid platforms
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and policies ensuring security, scalability, and operational consistency
* Drive resilience strategies including disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure risk management



**Cloud \& Platform Leadership** 



* Lead multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments
* Oversee cloud migration, optimization, and cloud\-native adoption across business units
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code and automation frameworks to accelerate deployment and scalability
* Build strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and leading infrastructure providers



**Operations \& Service Excellence** 



* Own end\-to\-end IT infrastructure operations and service delivery across all business units
* Implement ITIL\-aligned service management practices, including incident, change, and problem management
* Ensure 24/7 monitoring, performance optimization, and uptime across critical systems
* Establish SLAs, KPIs, and continuous improvement frameworks for operational excellence



**Commercial \& Financial Leadership** 



* Own infrastructure P\&L including total cost of ownership across on\-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Develop business cases for infrastructure investments, clearly articulating ROI and value realization
* Drive FinOps maturity, including cost transparency, showback/chargeback models, and cloud optimization strategies
* Lead negotiations with hyperscalers, telecom providers, and strategic vendors to optimize commercial outcomes
* Establish infrastructure unit economics (e.g., cost per workload, user, or transaction) to enable data\-driven decisions
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure governance, cost control, and scalable investment planning



**Network, Data Center \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee infrastructure lifecycle across compute, storage, and networking environments
* Lead network strategy including LAN, WAN, and connectivity across multiple assets and locations
* Drive virtualization, containerization, and platform optimization initiatives
* Ensure robust infrastructure security and performance across all environments



**Agentic AI\-Ready Infrastructure** 



* Architect AI\-native infrastructure platforms supporting large\-scale deployment of AI agents and advanced workloads
* Lead transition toward autonomous operations, including self\-healing infrastructure and predictive operations
* Enable intelligent orchestration of infrastructure resources based on real\-time demand and business context
* Define strategy for GPU and compute environments supporting AI, LLMs, and advanced analytics workloads
* Establish governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop frameworks for AI\-driven infrastructure operations
* Drive cultural transformation toward AI\-enabled operations and reduced manual intervention



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** 



* Partner with executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with strategic priorities
* Manage vendor ecosystem including cloud providers, MSPs, and telecom partners
* Oversee contract negotiations, performance management, and vendor governance frameworks
* Ensure alignment with security, architecture, and governance functions across the enterprise



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Build and lead high\-performing infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams
* Define organization structure and capability roadmap across infrastructure and cloud functions
* Drive talent development, certifications, and future skills in cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled operations
* Foster collaboration across IT and business units to deliver integrated technology services



  





**Who we are looking for** 



* 18\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud, and operations, with significant leadership exposure in complex enterprise environments
* Proven track record in leading large\-scale infrastructure and cloud transformations
* Strong experience managing multi\-vendor ecosystems and enterprise\-scale infrastructure platforms
* Deep expertise across data centers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and network environments
* Demonstrated experience in financial management of infrastructure, including cost optimization and vendor commercial strategies
* Experience operating at executive level, influencing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field required
* Master’s degree preferred
* Certifications in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) highly valued
* ITIL, infrastructure, or project management certifications advantageous



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Enterprise infrastructure architecture (compute, storage, networking, virtualization)
* Cloud computing platforms and hybrid/multi\-cloud strategies
* Infrastructure automation, orchestration, and IaC frameworks
* Network architecture, security, and performance management
* IT service management and ITIL practices
* Infrastructure financial management and cost optimization



  





**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking and transformation leadership
* Strong commercial and business acumen
* Executive stakeholder management and influence
* Problem solving and decision\-making in complex environments
* Ability to lead large, diverse technical teams



  





 As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.
 



  





 This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Role Summary**
 The Customer Service Manager (CSM) is responsible for the day\-to\-day performance and stability of customer service operations in a fast\-paced fintech environment. This role requires a hands\-on, data\-driven leader with experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, capable of translating operational data into actionable insights. The CSM will drive service performance through queue management, capacity planning, root cause analysis (RCA), and Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, while working closely with internal teams and outsourced partners to deliver consistent, compliant, and high\-quality customer outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Insights (CSM Level)**
* Analyse customer service performance metrics including SLA, FCR, CSAT, NPS, AHT, backlog, abandonment, and repeat contacts
* Identify trends and drivers behind performance movements and translate them into clear operational actions
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for key issue types (e.g. remittance status checks, escalations, repeat contacts)
* Own and contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, highlighting recurring customer pain points and improvement opportunities
* Provide structured, insight\-led updates to the Head of Customer Service and senior stakeholders.


**Operational Service Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day customer service operations across voice, tickets, email, and in\-app support channels
* Oversee high\-volume call centre operations, ensuring queue health, responsiveness, and service stability
* Monitor ticket backlogs, ageing, and abandonment rates, taking corrective action where required
* Manage escalations, including coordination with internal teams and third\-party partners
* Lead and participate in daily stand\-ups to track performance, risks, and priorities


**Capacity Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Track service demand versus available capacity by channel and product
* Identify capacity gaps and support short\-term and medium\-term workforce planning
* Monitor agent productivity, utilisation, and adherence
* Support SLA and KPI discussions with outsourced partners using data\-backed insights


**CRM \& Process Discipline**
* Ensure consistent and accurate use of the CRM, including: a) Ticket logging and categorisation b) Status updates and escalation handling c) Routing and workflow adherence
* Maintain strong data hygiene to support reliable reporting and analysis
* Identify process inefficiencies or system gaps based on hands\-on operational experience


**People Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide hands\-on coaching and real\-time guidance to agents and team leads
* Reinforce service quality standards, communication best practices, and escalation protocols
* Act as a first point of support for complex or sensitive customer cases
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus


**Requirements**
* Proven experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services
* Strong data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance metrics and drive actions
* Hands\-on experience with CRM systems (ticketing, routing, reporting)
* Experience leading RCA and VoC analysis to drive service and process improvements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with Product, Tech, Risk, and outsourced partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, regulated environment Desirable.
* Experience working with outsourced BPO partners.
* Exposure to fintech products such as payments, wallets, lending, or merchant services.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations in customer service operations. Success Measures
* Improved SLA, FCR, CSAT, and abandonment performance
* Reduced backlog and ageing tickets.
* Clear, actionable RCA and VoC insights influencing operational improvements.
* Stable and predictable day\-to\-day service delivery.
* Improved agent productivity and consistency

**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms.  Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Be responsible for driving delivery of large scale internal development and vendor tender across Emirates Network Operations. The environment is fast paced, with tight timelines and high operational impact. The focus is on delivering internally built systems as well as tendering for a large vendor implementations.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification

* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Experience in operational domains such as network operations, crew management or rostering will be an advantage, particularly where delivery impacts live operations.


 Leadership Role: Yes

 Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Job description:
   

  

 Purpose of the Job
 
 The Senior Director of Industrial Engineering \& Network Design is a pivotal leadership role responsible for transforming Aramex’s regional operating model. This position spearheads initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and financial optimization across multiple operational geographies, ensuring the network meets the demands of a dynamic logistics landscape.
 


* Drive the strategic design and execution of innovative operating models tailored to regional challenges and opportunities.
* Develop comprehensive cost frameworks integrating fixed, variable, and semi\-variable expenditures for transparent financial management.
* Deliver actionable insights through full transparency of productivity and performance metrics across the operational footprint.


 Job Description
 * Lead a comprehensive evaluation and redesign of Aramex’s regional operating model, defining clear roles and interfaces for hubs, facilities, and last\-mile operations to optimize service delivery and network integration.
* Establish and implement standardized engineering and operational processes designed to modernize current workflows, enhance consistency, and promote best practices region\-wide.
* Create and enforce robust governance structures that unify operational methodologies, ensuring harmonized practices and improved collaboration across diverse markets.
* Design and refine the fixed, variable, and semi\-variable cost model to accurately allocate expenses and identify clear levers for cost optimization and financial performance enhancement.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive operational productivity metrics alongside dynamic performance dashboards to provide real\-time visibility and facilitate data\-driven decision\-making.
* Champion strategic initiatives aimed at reducing cost\-to\-serve and enhancing cost\-per\-piece metrics by leveraging engineering insights and operational analytics.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for network planning inclusive of facility productivity targets, resource allocation strategies, and load/capacity modeling to maximize operational efficiencies.
* Support operational teams through process redesigns, load capacity charts, and engineering\-backed performance planning tools that enable proactive resource and workflow management.
* Leverage data\-driven scenario simulations and productivity analyses to underpin critical business decisions, promoting transparency and objective evaluation.
* Lead cultural transformation efforts to transition legacy operational mindsets towards agile, adaptive, and performance\-focused behavioral models that align with strategic objectives.
* Exert influence and mobilize cross\-functional, multi\-country teams by building strong relationships, advocating for change, and fostering commitment to new operating principles without direct line authority.
* Communicate vision, progress, and outcomes of transformation initiatives clearly and consistently to stakeholders at regional and country levels to ensure alignment and sustained engagement.


 Job Requirements \- Experience and Education
 * Bachelor's degree in Engineering is essential; master's level or higher qualifications in Engineering, Supply Chain, or related fields are preferred to demonstrate advanced expertise.
* Over 15 years of progressive experience in designing, implementing, or transforming operational and engineering models within logistics, transportation, or network\-centric industries.
* Proven track record working in complex, multi\-country environments, managing diverse teams and navigating regional regulatory and market nuances effectively.
* Deep expertise in operating model development, engineering planning disciplines, and continuous process improvement strategies within large\-scale operations.
* Strong financial literacy with demonstrated experience building detailed cost frameworks, enabling sound budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Competency in developing and deploying KPI frameworks, productivity measurement models, and integrated performance dashboards that support operational excellence.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale change management and transformational initiatives with the ability to align diverse stakeholders and drive adoption.
* Exceptional influencing and interpersonal skills, capable of guiding cross\-functional teams across regions without direct hierarchical control.



**Application Deadline: June 1st, 2026** 




 Aramex encourages and welcomes applications from talented individuals who are passionate about driving innovative operational transformations. Join our energetic and inclusive team to contribute to shaping the future of logistics in the region. We look forward to your application before the deadline and the opportunity to collaborate on impactful projects within a global industry leader. Apply today to be part of this exciting journey!

* Simplification
* Collaborate \& break silos
* Execution \& Accountability
* Growth mindset
* Innovation
* Inclusion
* External focus


 Skills

* Network Planning and Design
* Industrial Engineering

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
 SC Ventures is Standard Chartered’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served.
   

  

 We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together.
   

  

 We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy \& Lifestyle, SMEs \& World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability \& Inclusion.
   

  

 We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Innovation and Venture Designer is a senior individual contributor at the forefront of shaping what banking can become next. Reporting to and supporting the Head of Innovation and Design, this role will define, design, and deliver customer\-centric digital and service experiences across the SC Ventures portfolio, turning bold ideas into ventures that can scale in market.
   

  

 This is a role for someone energised by change, ambiguity, and the challenge of building in fast\-moving markets. The role holder will apply human\-centred design and product design expertise to unlock better customer outcomes, accelerate venture validation, and strengthen product\-market fit. The role carries Director\-level accountability, autonomy, and influence, working closely with venture CEOs, product leaders, engineers, and senior stakeholders to shape high\-impact decisions.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Proposition Shaping**
* Support the shaping of bold, differentiated venture concepts grounded in emerging trends across AI, fintech, and digital business models.
* Apply strong commercial acumen and customer insight to focus efforts on high\-potential opportunity spaces and translate them into compelling venture hypotheses.
* Work closely with venture leads, technologists, investors, and senior stakeholders to develop and refine co\-created early\-stage venture ideas.
* Leverage AI augmentation and modern design tools to accelerate ideation, concept development, and early prototyping.


**Proposition Validation**
* Turn bold venture ideas into tangible prototypes that can be tested with real users and evaluated for seed investment by the Investment Committee.
* Run fast, hands\-on validation cycles to test assumptions, gather customer insight, and build robust evidence for or against investment decisions.
* Rapidly design, prototype, and iterate using modern tools including Figma and AI tools such as Claude.
* Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives and artifacts that are simple, decision\-ready, and investment\-grade.


**Product Design \& Venture Build**
* Apply strong UX, service design, and prototyping craft to move from ambiguity to clarity at speed, shaping intuitive and high\-impact user experiences.
* Support ventures post\-seed by refining early\-stage product, user journeys, and experience design.
* Create prototypes and product concepts that bridge strategy, technology, and customer experience.
* Embed AI augmentation into product design to enhance user value, differentiation, and scalability.
* Ensure alignment between customer needs, business viability, and technical feasibility across early\-stage product development.


**Overall Mindset**
* Be comfortable operating in zero\-to\-one environments, balancing creativity, speed, and rigour.
* Bring a solid understanding of fintech ecosystems and digital business models, with sound commercial judgment.
* Thrive in a fast\-moving, experimental environment where building, testing, and learning quickly matters most..


**Risk Management**
* Adhere to Policies and Procedures.
* Act and escalate quickly when any risk and control weakness become apparent and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees.
* Work with SCV colleagues to deliver expected business performance results within cost constraints and applicable risk/ control framework to ensure that the Group’s ability to remain within risk appetite is not materially threatened.


**Governance**
* Have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Head of Innovation and Design
* Venture leads
* SC Ventures leadership


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


**Skills And Experience**
* Influence
* UX/UI Design
* Innovation
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Thinking


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years’ experience across facilitation, product design, product commercialisation, innovation design, UX/UI and/or consulting
* Experience working in AI augmented or automation rich product environments, leveraging AI tools or agents to accelerate discovery and delivery
* Ability to define intent, constraints, and evaluation criteria for AI generated outputs across design and innovation workflows
* Strong systems thinking: comfortable designing workflows, guardrails, and governance rather than only artefacts
* Proven track record designing complex, customer\-facing digital products at scale
* Strong expertise in UX research, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping (Claude Code/Cursor in addition to Figma)
* Experience operating at Director\-level influence without formal people management
* Strong understanding of agile product development and cross\-functional delivery models
* Ability to clearly articulate design decisions to senior, non\-design stakeholders


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes.  As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Senior Manager \- Commercial Asset Management** 
 . In this role, you will be responsible for maximizing the value and performance of Shamal Holding’s hospitality asset portfolio. The role involves strategic oversight of hotel operators, performance monitoring, capital planning, and ensuring that the assets meet financial and operational targets. The role will also support new acquisitions, expansions and developments by providing asset\-level insights and lead execution of projects.
   

  

**Asset Performance \& Strategy**
* Lead the development and execution of asset strategies to enhance asset value and returns.
* Monitor financial and operational KPIs of the hospitality portfolio.
* Analyse monthly and quarterly performance reports from hotel operators and provide insights to leadership.
* Benchmark performance against market data and competitive set.


**Operator Management**
* Act as the key liaison between Shamal and hotel operators, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Review annual budgets, business plans, marketing plans, and capital expenditure plans.
* Ensure compliance with management agreements, brand standards, and operating covenants.


**Financial \& Investment Analysis**
* Perform financial modelling, scenario analysis, and valuation of existing and potential assets.
* Assist in the underwriting of new hospitality investments and developments.
* Work closely with finance and investment teams to support strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate and assess annual budgets and projections.


**Capital Planning \& Project Oversight**
* Oversee capital expenditure projects and renovations to ensure timelines and budgets are met.
* Support in repositioning or rebranding strategies to improve asset performance.


**Project Management and Committee approvals**
* Oversee all capital expenditure projects for approval.
* Upon approval, manage their completion to ensure adherence to the allocated budget.


**Reporting \& Governance**
* Prepare and present asset performance reports to senior management and stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to internal governance, risk, and compliance frameworks.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as hospitality, strategy, finance, or business administration is required.
* Certification in hospitality analytics, real estate or asset management.
* 8\-10 years of experience in hospitality, F\&B, asset management, hotel consulting, investment, or related fields.
* Strong knowledge of hotel operations, P\&L analysis, contract negotiation, and operator management.

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Business Development, Corporate Solutions \- B2B Acceptance
   

  

**Overview**
 This role sits within Corporate Solutions and is responsible for developing and scaling Mastercard’s B2B Acceptance strategy across East \+ West Arabia and Eastern Europe. You will help acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants unlock new commercial payment flows.
   

  

 B2B Acceptance is a significant growth opportunity. Corporate buyers increasingly want to pay suppliers using commercial and virtual cards, particularly for invoice\-based payments. For acquirers and merchants, this creates an opportunity to capture new high\-value flows, improve cash flow, reduce manual processes and enable better reconciliation through data and straight\-through processing.
   

  

 Key questions
   

  

* Do you have a track record of building and scaling commercial payment products or acceptance\-led growth strategies?
* Can you influence senior executives across banks, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and large merchants?
* Are you motivated by solving commercial and operational problems through technology, data and partnerships?
* Can you turn market trends into execution plans that drive GDV, revenue and merchant activation?


 Role
   

  

* Develop and execute the EEMEA B2B Acceptance strategy to retain, grow and expand Mastercard’s commercial acceptance footprint.
* Drive incremental commercial volume and revenue by enabling acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants to capture high\-value B2B and invoice\-based payment flows.
* Remove operational barriers to B2B acceptance, including onboarding friction, manual processing, reconciliation challenges, supplier education and acceptance visibility.
* Build and scale market strategies for virtual card acceptance, supplier enablement, straight\-through processing and automated reconciliation.
* Provide thought leadership to global product teams on B2B merchant, acquiring, fintech, PSP, AP/AR, ERP and embedded finance opportunities.
* Lead digital presence, market insights, research and sales enablement for Commercial Acceptance across Eastern Europe and the Middle East.
* Build educational collateral and go\-to\-market playbooks to support banks, acquirers, fintechs, merchants and internal teams.
* Partner with Commercial Solutions, issuers, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and account teams to activate commercial acceptance assets and partnerships.
* Manage dashboards and KPIs covering merchant activation, supplier enablement, GDV, net revenue, pipeline conversion and partner performance.
* Ensure Mastercard resources are deployed effectively to support commercial outcomes, market priorities and scalable regional growth.


**All About You**
* Strong understanding of acquiring, merchant economics, commercial card acceptance, virtual cards and B2B payment flows.
* Proven ability to build and scale product value propositions, particularly across acquiring, merchant or supplier enablement.
* Experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, ERP, procurement, embedded finance or invoice\-based payments is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial mindset, with experience managing revenue growth, pipeline execution, business performance or P\&L\-related outcomes.
* Executive presence and consultative sales experience, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to use data to build business cases, track performance and shape strategy.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial and execution\-focused, with the ability to work across a matrixed organization and turn strategy into measurable outcomes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The PMO Manager plays a key role in promoting cross\-stream alignment, implementing communication and escalation plans, and providing guidance to the project management team to achieve organizational goals.
   

  

**As a part of your job, you will:**

* Transformation Management Office: develop and maintain integrated business transformation agenda which aligns to the OU/market vision and strategic KPIs
* Lead several key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives: as aligned with senior stakeholders
* Change Management


**Responsibilities**
* Operating Model

* Provide Program leadership to Next Chapter for OU/market. Working with OU Next Chapter PMO and CMO, and Region team, to land Next Chapter organization, processes and ways of working, per aligned OU roadmap

 Key Skills/Experience Required

* Thinking: Excellent strategic mindset and thinking skills, forward\-thinking, ability to think holistically E2E and connect the dots, ability to frame the right questions and develop frameworks and solutions to solve complex problems. Highly analytical, motivated, decisive thought leader with excellent general management skills – strong bias for action and can\-do approach to work, “out of the box” thinking using traditional and non\-traditional information sources to support recommendations and drive business results.

Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery
* Agility: flexibility and willingness to take on diverse and challenging tasks, passion for supporting and managing change. Ability to operate in through ambiguity and adapt to changing priorities. Demonstrates courage and conviction required to lead scale changes initiatives and embrace new ways of working.

**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

data.jd_text:
Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

 In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.
   

  

 We have been present in Saudi Arabia for 40 years and with over 600 employees to date, we are growing rapidly. Together we are delivering our signalling, control and train protection systems for the North –South Railway (NSR), the longest system of it’s kind in the world. Together we are key suppliers of In\-flight entertainment and connectivity systems as well as air traffic management solutions in Saudi. We are making Saudi Arabia a safer place by securing the country’s critical infrastructure and e\-security solutions that secure the country’s electronic payment systems. Thales has been selected to supply major electronic systems for air defence and the Group also supplied communication and optronic systems for the Army, the Saudi Arabia National Guards and the Air Force.
   

  

**JOB OBJECTIVE:**
 As a Project Manager within the Platforms Services \& Delivery team you will ensure that a project is completed on time and will deliver solutions that meet both customers’ requirements and our commitments. Your role will directly contribute to internal and external customer satisfaction which is key for business growth.
   

  

**A week in the life of a Project Manager:**
* You will drive the project to ensure customer satisfaction by meeting deadlines, quality specifications and project profitability; and lead customer interactions for the project
* You will deliver solutions that are cost effective, easy to operate and generate value
* You will provide visibility of the project progress, obtain the necessary resources and identify and resolve issues; and manage the financial aspects of projects including costs and revenue
* You will manage project risks and related action plans
* You will manage change requests and identify new business opportunities
* You will maintain communications with stakeholders and the project organization: Solution Manager, Project Delivery team, Technical Leaders, Support \& Maintenance team.
* Responsible for the change management of the project (organize and lead the bug reviews to determine the priority of bug fixing in line with the Customer’s priorities)
* Responsible for validating the Project Execution baseline prepared with the support of the SEM prior to submitting it to the Supervisory Authority for final approval during the Launch Review, and to maintain this Project Execution baseline throughout the project lifecycle
* Responsible for the Project Kick\-off meeting
* Responsible for Project Reviews as defined in Manage Project Process
* Responsible for obtaining the Customer Acceptance of the delivered solution
* Responsible for the Closure Review
* Responsible for the collection of Lessons Learned from the project
* Responsible for the preparation and update of a log document to chronologically collect the events that happen during the project and that can support future claims
* Responsible to provide a reporting to the Senior Management (Supervisory Authority) through a dashboard encompassing all the necessary information to understand the progress made to date on the overall project activities and the forecasts about the activities which have to be performed until project completion


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**
 1\-To succeed at this job, you must have: at least 5 years’ experience in project management (specification, design and team), in the software development or service operation industry.
   

  

 2\- You must have Certification in PMI/PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner.
   

  

 3\- You must have an Engineer or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or computer engineering.
   

  

 4\- You must be fluent in English and Arabic.
   

  

 5\- You must be fluent in English and Arabic  We are looking for someone with the ability to learn our product and service offers’ use cases and eco\-systems and understand how our solutions work and how they are delivered; the ability to manage scope and requirements autonomously, build a project plan, monitor the project status, manage the customer relationship and project costs and use Microsoft Project.
   

  

 6\- customer relationship and project costs and use Microsoft Project  We would like someone to join our team who has good organizational, analytical and communication skills; who is a problem\-solver and team\-builder, able to inspire a shared vision and delegate tasks with a high level of integrity, able to work in a fast\-paced environment; who is quick learner and self\-starter.
   

  

 7\- We are looking for someone who is able to travel in case needed.
   

  

 8\- Mandatory Arabic speaker.
   

  

 9\- Able to travel.
   

  

 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

**Gold And Minerals Joint Stock Company**
 Gold and Minerals is a leading exploration and development company specializing in gold and base metal projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With a strong focus on sustainable and responsible mining practices, the company is committed to unlocking the Kingdom’s rich mineral potential while contributing to its economic growth.
   

  

 The company has a proven track record in discovering and developing high\-quality mineral resources, highlighted by the success of its flagship
 **Jabal Qutman Gold** 
 ,
 **Wadi Bidah Copper\-Gold and Ajlan JV** 
 projects, positioning it as one of the key players in Saudi Arabia’s growing mining sector. In response to the Kingdom’s strategic initiatives to expand the mining industry, Gold and Minerals is actively expanding its team to support its ambitious exploration and development programs.
   

  

 Our team consists of highly skilled, multinational geologists and mining professionals working collaboratively across resource expansion, project development, and greenfield exploration projects. We foster a dynamic, innovative, and safety\-focused work environment that encourages professional growth, knowledge sharing, and career advancement.
   

  

 At Gold and Minerals , we are passionate about creating value for our stakeholders while maintaining the highest standards of environmental stewardship and community engagement.
   

  

 Joining our team means being part of a forward\-thinking organization that is shaping the future of mining in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for providing strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the newly formed joint venture. Ensures execution of shareholders’ joint exploration, resource definition, project development, and assessment through to mining strategy and operational mine site. Drives value creation by ensuring safe business operations, efficient implementation, innovation, team development, adherence to timelines, and reporting requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver the JV’s work program as committed to MIM.
* Develop and execute work programs aligned with project requirements and exploration results to meet timelines.
* Manage operational functions and ensure delivery of approved plans.
* Assess and optimize future mining projects.
* Ensure safe operations across exploration, project definition, construction, and mining activities.
* Manage costs within approved budgets.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting to shareholders and MIM.
* Maintain strong governance standards, including procurement compliance.
* Lead and develop high\-performing leadership teams and promote a strong safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with legal, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including mining license applications.
* Represent both shareholders’ interests within the joint venture.
* Ensure effective engagement with local communities and stakeholders.


**Key Work Interactions**
 Internal Relationships
   

  

* Joint Venture Technical Committee
* Shareholders
* Employees
* Site General Managers and Operations
* Shareholder financial teams


 External Relationships
   

  

* Communities
* Government agencies and regulatory bodies
* Consultants and engineering firms
* Equipment and technology suppliers
* Adjacent license holders
* Contractors and service providers


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Mineral Processing, or related field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Health \& Safety certification is desirable
* Valid driving licence in KSA or convertible to KSA licence


**Experience**
* Minimum 15 years of experience in the mining industry, with at least 10 years in senior leadership roles
* Proven track record in managing advanced exploration projects and delivering feasibility studies
* Experience in coordinating multidisciplinary teams and transitioning projects from exploration to development and operations
* Experience in establishing new projects, including policy development, training, and HSE procedures
* Strong understanding of structurally controlled gold deposits, open pit mining, and precious metal processing
* Culturally adept and delivery\-focused
* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and communication skills


**Work Schedule**
 This role operates on a FIFO roster in a remote operational location, following a 6 weeks on / 3 weeks off rotation schedule.

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.

data.jd_text:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Directly manage and guide specialized technical leads, including the Incident managers, Support \& Operations team, Upgrade \& Deployment Lead, KPI Reporting \& Analytics Lead, Drive Test Lead, and Knowledge Transfer Lead.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Service Delivery Manager (SDM) provides oversight of the operational health of the customer system, from service delivery through lifecycle support. The SDM ensures and may manage internal \& external resources to deliver services and maintain their compliance with customer contractual commitments.
   

  

 The SDM establishes standard procedures designed to ensure consistently high service performance, monitors employees and evaluates customer feedback to develop quality improvement processes. The SDM is responsible for customer success as defined by success criteria during the transition phase
   

  

 A Service Delivery Manager is assigned to one or more of MSI’s customers depending on the size of the system and its complexity. A SDM is expected to have or develop a detailed knowledge of the customer’s system and their operational staff.
   

  

**Responsibility**
 The main role of the Service Delivery Manager is to facilitate customer success by adhering to global service delivery processes related to the customer. The Service Delivery Manager also acts as the main interface between MSI and the customer.
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing specialized Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) and deployment functions for the STC Nationwide Kodiak MCX network. Operating alongside the Customer Service Manager (CSM), the SDM leads dedicated technical teams to ensure seamless application upgrades, rigorous performance tracking, and effective knowledge transfer to support the mission\-critical environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Upgrades \& deployments: oversee the dedicated Upgrade and Deployment team (consisting of 4 personnel) responsible for executing software patching, rollbacks, updates, and deployment across all lab and production systems.
* Performance monitoring \&reporting: direct the KPI Reporting \& Analytics team to generate comprehensive system performance reports, Kodiak Analytic reports, and drive test reports to ensure service quality and SLA compliance.
* Testing \& verification: oversee change management verification, Wave mobile application acceptance testing, and drive testing operations (in coordination with 3rd party vendors).
* Knowledge transfer \& enablement: manage the Knowledge Transfer lead to facilitate comprehensive user engagement, onboarding, fleet mapping preparation, and continuous training development for the customer.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: work closely with the Customer Support Manager (CSM), Incident Managers, and supporting functions (like HR, Commercial, and Procurement) to align strategic goals and ensure continuous service improvement.


**Required Operating Environment Context**
 The role supports a 24x7x365 support model handling highly complex, mission\-critical push\-to\-talk (MCPTT) applications.
   

  

 The candidate will be subject to local Saudization requirements, which may require specific educational degrees related to the role to be granted a work permit.
   

  

 Deliverables
   

  

* Take part in the formulation of standard procedures regarding service delivery.
* Lead the transition and transformation of project operations to Managed Services.
* Ensure that procedures and plans formulated for the customer are in line with the organization’s goals.
* Ensure that procedures formulated are fully implemented to achieve service level objectives.
* Attend important meetings on behalf of the service delivery team or appoint representatives.
* Make recommendations for changes to technology or procedures for the customer.
* Prepare periodic reports and present such reports to the customer stakeholders.
* Analysis of system performance and facilitate improvement recommendations.


 Cost and Efficiency
   

  

 A common fiscal responsibility of the Service Delivery Manager is to ensure delivery processes are efficient and cost effective. To reduce costs and streamline the process without adversely impacting the client experience, they might eliminate paperwork, unnecessary service steps or non\-value\-added features. For technology service providers, an emphasis should be placed on the efficient delivery of hardware and software services.
   

  

* Suggest new strategies to maintain or improve on the quality of service delivery \& minimize cost.
* Carry out research regularly and attend seminars to learn improved service delivery procedures and processes.


 Customer Satisfaction
   

  

 A key role for the service delivery manager is to constantly assess customer feedback and make necessary improvements. Managers typically conduct evaluations with customers on the phone, in person, via e\-mail or through postal mail. When scores fall below the preset thresholds, the manager may conduct additional research and take steps to correct deficiencies. For example, some customers might feel like parts of the process are slow or delayed. By identifying and analyzing the issues, the service delivery manager can work on eliminating bottlenecks.
   

  

* Collect data and information on client satisfaction, inquiry, and complaint.
* Plan, manage and execute customer meetings for service delivery reporting and improvements.
* He/she will ensure that clients’ satisfaction is always guaranteed and will consistently collate data on customer satisfaction, inquiry and complaint.
* Responsible for maintaining a positive relationship with customers.
* identifying customer needs and ensuring that the service provider is able to meet these needs with an appropriate catalogue of services.
* The Service Delivery Manager has responsibility for being the Customer’s advocate within Motorola and being Motorola’s face to the Customer.
* Support the customer to best use the features and deliverables of Managed Service.
* Performs analysis of issues and problems.
* Lead efforts to escalate across internal functional groups to resolve service or client business impacting issues.
* Provides support relative to contractual commitments and SLA's.


 Management
   

  

* Educate the members of the service delivery team on new plans and implication on service delivery.
* Assess the individual and collective performance of the team members.
* Organize and head meetings with the service delivery team.
* Responsible for training of service delivery resources.
* Reporting.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

* Diploma or degree in Engineering (Electrical) or related discipline
* ITIL v4 certification
* High level of understanding of Communication systems and IP Networks
* 2\+ years experience with planning and transitioning a project to operations and maintenance phase
* 5\+ years experience managing a service delivery team, ideally focused on operations and maintenance
* High\-level experience in telecoms or public safety
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and presentation in English and Arabic)
* Excellent customer service skills with a focus on Total Customer Satisfaction
* Effective consultation and liaison skills
* Good planning and time management skills
* Ability to prioritise, multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Excellent theoretical and practical problem\-solving skills
* Well\-developed interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Ability to work unsupervised
* Technical literacy


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 25\-50%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 Domestic
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No
   

  

**Company**
 Motorola Solutions Arabia, Inc., Saudi Branch
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world.
